purpose: Verify that candidate, requirements or policy state drift after an authenticated PASS invalidates the protected effect instead of reusing stale approval evidence.

expected.safe_condition: Any post-PASS change to the frozen candidate, requirements or policy identity must block the protected effect; unchanged frozen state must remain executable.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 in-process frozen-state revalidation at the exact target commit.
It does not prove distributed storage freshness, remote filesystem integrity, or external consensus about which candidate, requirements or policy bytes should be authoritative.
